strings.prologue.p1.war: The war that began in 1939 ended without a victor.
strings.prologue.p1.line: In 1953 the front froze into a line running across Eastern Europe.
strings.prologue.p2.empires: West of the Line, the German Reich; east of it, the Soviet Union – two dictatorships.
strings.prologue.p2.veltrava: On the Line lies the Free City of Veltrava – neutral, full of exiles and spies.
strings.prologue.p2.accord: In 1963 the Corridor Treaty was signed there: three rail routes across the Line.
strings.prologue.p2.trains: Since then, trains have been running again – with grain, coal and medicine.
strings.prologue.p3.papers: Every load travels with waybills, stamps and index cards.
strings.prologue.p3.c17: Some of them bear the same contract number: C-17.
strings.prologue.p4.konrad: In Berlin, Konrad Adler draws building plans for the new capital.
strings.prologue.p5.alexei: In Karsk, Alexei Morozov repairs signals and points.
strings.prologue.p5.politics: Politics, he says, is other people’s business.
strings.prologue.p5.strangers: The two of them have not yet met.
